reference_sql:
SELECT parent_category,
       SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur,
       SUM(units * unit_cost_eur) AS cost_eur,
       SUM(net_revenue_eur) - SUM(units * unit_cost_eur) AS margin_eur
FROM sales
WHERE net_revenue_eur IS NOT NULL AND units IS NOT NULL AND unit_cost_eur IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY parent_category
